subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should maintainers require visible latest-head proof for the legacy no-code SQLite upgrade path before this PR can land, or accept the source/tests as enough for that compatibility path?
rationale: The code direction matches the predecessor review, but the legacy branch changes upgraded persisted-state behavior and the external PR proof gate is not satisfied for that branch.

options.title: Require Legacy Upgrade Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, copied live output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code SQLite diagnostics_json row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds on the current PR head.

options.title: Accept Source And Test Proof
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly override the external proof gap and accept the regression tests plus source inspection as enough for the legacy upgrade behavior.

options.title: Move Legacy Cleanup Out Of Runtime
options.body: Pause this PR if runtime invalidation for legacy no-code rows is not the desired compatibility contract and require doctor or migration-owned cleanup instead.

recommendation.title: Require Legacy Upgrade Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, copied live output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code SQLite diagnostics_json row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds on the current PR head.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about persisted SQLite plugin registry upgrade behavior, where steipete has the strongest recent history.
